title: Change requests
intro: Material changes to approved scope, baselines, targets, the target operating model, cost, benefit logic or schedule go through a change request with a reason and an impact preview. The original approval and its snapshot stay unchanged.
businessApproval: A change request is decided in a business approval inside the product, routed by the decision rights (T11). Engineering delivery gates are never involved.
readOnly: You can read change requests here; raising or configuring them needs another role.

origin.automatic: Automatic (raised by the system on a material change)

t11.none: the default approver of this kind

list.title: Change requests
list.intro: Every request on this transformation, newest first. Open one to see its proposed values, impact and approval.
list.emptyBody: A request appears here when someone raises one, or automatically when a material change is made to an approved record.

form.title: Raise a change request
form.description: Choose the approved record, the kind of change and the new values. The current values are shown as they are recorded.
form.draftOnly: Creating saves a draft only. Nothing is routed or approved until you submit it.
form.subjectHint: Only an approved record goes through change control; a draft is edited directly.
form.effectiveFromHint: Leave empty to apply from now on. A past date is a retrospective restatement, which is not supported.
form.kpiNoDraft: This KPI has no draft version. Create a draft version with the new values on the KPI page first; the request proposes that draft.
form.kpiDiffIntro: The draft version changes these fields of the active version:
form.kpiNoDifference: The draft version changes none of the definition, baseline or target fields.
form.milestoneDates: Approved date: {{approved}} · Forecast date: {{forecast}} (the forecast is shown separately and is not changed by this request)

materiality.noThreshold: no threshold configured: every change of this kind is material
materiality.kindMaterial: this kind of change is always material

reason.calendar_not_configured: no working calendar is configured, so the shift is Unknown and counted as material
reason.unknown_value: a current value is Unknown, so the change is counted as material
reason.zero_base: the current value is zero, so no ratio applies and the change is material
reason.other: the basis is Unknown, so the change is counted as material

preview.title: Impact preview
preview.intro: Computed now from the current records; nothing is frozen until the request is submitted.
preview.completeFirst: Choose the record, the kind and at least one new value to preview the impact.

assessments.title: Impact assessments (frozen)
assessments.intro: Each submitted version froze its impact assessment; it never changes afterwards. Its SHA-256 identifies the content.
assessments.empty: No assessment yet: one is frozen when the request is submitted.
assessments.heading: Version {{n}} · {{items}} items

impact.hidden: {{n}} affected records are outside what you may read; they are counted, not shown.
impact.gatePreserved: {{gate}} business approval (submission {{no}}) is preserved unchanged; this change needs reapproval through this request.
impact.pinnedVersion: The approved snapshot pins formula version {{n}}.

detail.title: Change request
detail.heading: Change request {{code}}
detail.editIntro: Change the reason or the proposed new values. A returned request is submitted again as round 2 after this edit.
detail.submitBody: Submitting assesses materiality, freezes the impact assessment of this version and routes the request to its approver. It cannot be edited while it is in approval.
detail.resubmitBody: Submitting again freezes a new impact assessment for this version and resubmits the same business approval as the next round.
detail.withdrawBody: The request is withdrawn and nothing is applied.
detail.withdrawInApprovalBody: The request is in approval: its business approval is withdrawn with it, in one step. Nothing is applied.
detail.draftNote: Saved draft — not submitted. It has no materiality, routing or approval yet.
detail.returnedNote: Returned for changes by the approver. Edit it, then submit again as the next round.
detail.requesterOnly: Only the requester can submit this request again or withdraw it while it is in approval.
detail.routeFallback: default approver: the T11 row is not in this transformation's copy
detail.appliedVersion: The record is now at version {{n}}; earlier values remain in this request and the audit trail.

policy.title: Materiality policy
policy.intro: Thresholds decide when a schedule or budget change is material. Without a threshold, every change of that kind is material.
policy.noThreshold: No threshold: every change is material
policy.editIntro: Leave a field empty for no threshold. Days are 0 to 250; the ratio is a fraction from 0 to 10 (0.1 = 10 %).
policy.firstSave: This is the first save of the policy for this transformation.
policy.dateShiftHint: A schedule rebaseline beyond this many working days is material.
policy.budgetRatioHint: A cost change whose |new − old| / |old| exceeds this ratio is material.
